notes.title: Gigantic Update - 78 Levels, Open World
notes.notes:
Levels have been increased from 18 to 78

 Open world concept, where you have open access to multiple levels, thus adding the luxury of playing a diverse set of levels from the very start

 The graphics have improved, displaying messages and level introductions

 The Storyline has been cut out, providing a more user friendly experience

 Wait times have been sped up, to get the user engaged in playing quicker than ever

 Collect over 230 Pysankas "Little Ukrainian Eggs"

notes.title: Update V2.0
notes.notes:
- New Menu System
- New Help Menu "Orange CPU"
- New, Cleaner Graphics
- Fixed Many Bugs
- Introduction has been remade for faster start time
- Internal work done to make the game run smoother
